description: Runs one Knos tool on a file, as the Knos site does, with the same limits and the same free runs a day: for limit-check, a comma separated table, the column to check, the rule (above or below) and the limit. Returns the result sentence, the first failing row, the rows checked, the rows skipped, the test that showed the program works, and the result's link.

column.description: a column name from the file's header, or "column 1", "column 2" and so on when it has none

limit.description: the limit; a value equal to it fails

rule.description: whether the values must stay above or below the limit

table.description: the file as text, comma separated

name: run
title: Run a Knos tool
